title: Apollo 13 component-current and battery-history validation cases
qualification: Source-constrained hypotheses and held-out observations. Separate optional LM-8 design-power overlay, explicit thermostat sensitivity and conditional initial histories; full flight validation remains open.

sources.title: LM-7 and subsequent Operations Handbook, Volume I
sources.locator: Equipment input-power ledger; EPS Figure 2.5-2; control tables; RCS heater section 2.4.3.4.2
sources.qualification: Original LM-7 input watts take precedence over LM-8 values. Protective breaker ratings are not operating loads.

sources.title: LM-8 Systems Handbook, HSI-208818
sources.qualification: Explicit cross-vehicle design-power proxy. Its application to LM-7 is an assumption, not established vehicle-specific telemetry. See electrical-flight-loads.json receipts and exclusions.

sources.title: Apollo 13 air-to-ground power-down commands
sources.qualification: Commands/readbacks constrain a partial state. Individual grouped breaker execution times and omitted baseline states remain unknown.

sources.title: Apollo 13 manual midcourse configuration calls
sources.locator: 104:32:41 heaters; 104:58:11 AGS activation; 105:17:07 gimbal OFF; 105:17:58 engine arm DES; 105:43:59 power-down; 105:52:40 amplifier breaker
sources.qualification: Uses crew and CapCom configuration calls only. The later PAO current report is reserved for comparison. Exact unsaid breaker motion times are not inferred.

sources.title: Apollo 13 Battery 2 isolation and restoration calls
sources.qualification: Manual contactor/cross-tie commands are replayed. The false warning does not invent an automatic disconnection or a signed transient current.

sources.title: Mission Operations Report, TELMU
sources.qualification: Battery 6 online 111:57, Battery 5 online 133:30, Battery 3 removal 139:16; normal rather than backup ascent feed selection remains an explicit assumption.

sources.title: Apollo 13 Mission Report initial electrical capacity
sources.qualification: Reported 2179 Ah at LM power-up. Exact epoch and individual battery distribution are not established. Proportional allocation is conditional.

sources.title: TELMU charger input and crew charging sequence
sources.locator: TELMU G-6 about 8 A; charge/pause/changeover calls recorded in electrical-flight-audit.json
sources.qualification: Nominal 8 A is a scenario input during selected documented windows, never a reconstructed waveform or CM charge-restoration model. Other CM demand remains unknown.

sources.title: Apollo 13 late LM reactivation calls
sources.qualification: Grouped modeled guidance reactivation at the reported start is an assumed schedule; exact per-switch execution history is absent.

sources.title: Mission Operations Report electrical hourly summary
sources.qualification: Reported present draw 11.8 A. Resolution alone is not a calibration, timing or total model-uncertainty allowance.

sources.title: Contemporaneous PAO manual midcourse current report
sources.qualification: Around 25 A during the burn; no calibrated tolerance or complete current-versus-time trace is provided. Not used to select equipment watts or duties.

sources.title: Contemporaneous PAO post-midcourse current report
sources.qualification: Reported 10-12 A after completed power-down. No extra acceptance allowance has been established.

sources.title: Mission Operations Report charge-period hourly summary
sources.qualification: Reported total source current 19.2 A; not an LM-equipment-only current to which export can be added.

sources.title: TELMU Battery 3 withdrawal history
sources.qualification: Reported 394 Ah delivered and less than 1 A immediately before removal. Model current is sampled before the forced disconnection; initial per-battery history remains unknown.

sources.title: Apollo 13 Mission Report total reserve endpoint
sources.qualification: 410 Ah total remaining. Distinct from 189.6 Ah usable reserve. No acceptance band or source-ledger boundary is inferred.
